sams.strength: High physiological composure under pressure with minimal baseline discomfort.
sams.gap: Elevated sympathetic nerves threshold leading to hesitation or tension when challenged.

phantasia.strength: Effortless mental image generation allowing dynamic storytelling without notes.
phantasia.gap: Abstract conceptual focus making unscripted visual descriptions harder to sustain.

vocal.strength: Dynamic range in pitch and volume with uninhibited vocal release.
vocal.gap: Restricted vocal range or static volume causing monotone delivery patterns.

visual.strength: High visual word percentage with balanced pacing across both prompt styles.
visual.gap: Struggles to maintain visual sensory detail when increasing speaking pace.

repeat.strength: Rapid recall and accurate delivery under categorical constraint rules.
repeat.gap: Delayed response times or missing vocal activation when navigating strict category rules.
